For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,
O Lord, take me out of the power of the evil man; keep me safe from the violent man:
（大衛的詩，交與伶長。）耶和華啊，求你拯救我脫離凶惡的人，保護我脫離強暴的人！
who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.
For their hearts are full of evil designs; and they are ever making ready causes of war.
他們心中圖謀奸惡，常常聚集要爭戰。
They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah
Their tongues are sharp like the tongue of a snake; the poison of snakes is under their lips. (Selah.)
他們使舌頭尖利如蛇，嘴裡有虺蛇的毒氣。（細拉）
Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.
O Lord, take me out of the hands of sinners; keep me safe from the violent man: for they are designing my downfall.
耶和華啊，求你拯救我脫離惡人的手，保護我脫離強暴的人！他們圖謀推我跌倒。
The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah
The men of pride have put secret cords for my feet; stretching nets in my way, so that they may take me with their tricks. (Selah.)
驕傲人為我暗設網羅和繩索；他們在路旁鋪下網，設下圈套。（細拉）
I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.
I have said to the Lord, You are my God: give ear, O Lord, to the voice of my prayer.
我曾對耶和華說：你是我的神。耶和華啊，求你留心聽我懇求的聲音！
O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.
O Lord God, the strength of my salvation, you have been a cover over my head in the day of the fight.
主─耶和華、我救恩的力量啊，在爭戰的日子，你遮蔽了我的頭。
Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not promote their evil plans, lest they be exalted. Selah
O Lord, give not the wrongdoer his desire; give him no help in his evil designs, or he may be uplifted in pride. (Selah.)
耶和華啊，求你不要遂惡人的心願；不要成就他們的計謀，恐怕他們自高。（細拉）
May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.
As for those who come round me, let their heads be covered by the evil of their lips.
至於那些昂首圍困我的人，願他們嘴唇的奸惡陷害（原文是遮蔽）自己！
May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into the miry pits, never to rise again.
Let burning flames come down on them: let them be put into the fire, and into deep waters, so that they may not get up again.
願火炭落在他們身上！願他們被丟在火中，拋在深坑裡，不能再起來。
May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.
Let not a man of evil tongue be safe on earth: let destruction overtake the violent man with blow on blow.
說惡言的人在地上必堅立不住；禍患必獵取強暴的人，將他打倒。
I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.
I am certain that the Lord will take care of the cause of the poor, and of the rights of those who are troubled.
我知道耶和華必為困苦人伸冤，必為窮乏人辨屈。
Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.
Truly, the upright will give praise to your name: the holy will have a place in your house.
義人必要稱讚你的名；正直人必住在你面前。
